description: 驾驶习惯评分：效率（温度+空调补偿）、平稳（依据 Tesla Safety Score，可复议：急加/急刹 0.3g、急转 0.4g，按超阈时间占比；急转为 GPS 航向近似）、速度（按有效采样时长加权）、能量回收（按有效采样时长积分）。综合分按场景（城市/混合/高速）自适应权重 + 按里程加权汇总。

panels.title: 综合评分
panels.description: 按行程场景自适应权重（可复议：城市 avg_speed<50，混合 50-80，高速≥80），所有行程按里程加权平均。

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_drives AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT *
  FROM drives
  WHERE car_id = $car_id
    AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
    AND end_date IS NOT NULL
    AND distance > 3
),
points AS (
  SELECT p.drive_id, p.date, p.speed, p.power, p.latitude, p.longitude, d.distance, d.start_date,
    LEAD(p.date) OVER w AS next_date,
    LEAD(p.speed) OVER w AS next_speed,
    LEAD(p.latitude) OVER w AS next_lat,
    LEAD(p.longitude) OVER w AS next_lng,
    LEAD(p.date, 2) OVER w AS next2_date,
    LEAD(p.latitude, 2) OVER w AS next2_lat,
    LEAD(p.longitude, 2) OVER w AS next2_lng
  FROM positions p
  JOIN selected_drives d ON d.id = p.drive_id
  WHERE p.car_id = $car_id
    AND p.date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '1 day')
                   AND ($__timeTo()::timestamp + interval '1 day')
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY p.drive_id ORDER BY p.date)
),
segments AS (
  SELECT *,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_date - date)) AS dt,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next2_date - next_date)) AS next_dt,
    CASE WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND next_lat IS NOT NULL AND next_lng IS NOT NULL THEN
      ATAN2(
        SIN(RADIANS(next_lng - longitude)) * COS(RADIANS(next_lat)),
        COS(RADIANS(latitude)) * SIN(RADIANS(next_lat)) - SIN(RADIANS(latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(next_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(next_lng - longitude))
      )
    END AS bearing1,
    CASE WHEN next_lat IS NOT NULL AND next_lng IS NOT NULL AND next2_lat IS NOT NULL AND next2_lng IS NOT NULL THEN
      ATAN2(
        SIN(RADIANS(next2_lng - next_lng)) * COS(RADIANS(next2_lat)),
        COS(RADIANS(next_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(next2_lat)) - SIN(RADIANS(next_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(next2_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(next2_lng - next_lng))
      )
    END AS bearing2
  FROM points
),
valid_segments AS (
  SELECT *, dt AS valid_dt
  FROM segments
  WHERE dt BETWEEN 0.2 AND 10
),
pos_raw AS (
  SELECT drive_id, speed, power, distance, start_date, valid_dt,
    (next_speed - speed) / valid_dt / 3.6 AS accel_ms2,
    CASE
      -- 依据 Tesla Safety Score，可复议: 急转阈值 0.4g≈3.924m/s²；TeslaMate 无官方横向加速度时用 GPS 航向变化近似。
      WHEN next_dt BETWEEN 0.2 AND 10 AND speed > 5 AND bearing1 IS NOT NULL AND bearing2 IS NOT NULL THEN
        (speed / 3.6) * ABS(ATAN2(SIN(bearing2 - bearing1), COS(bearing2 - bearing1))) / NULLIF(valid_dt, 0)
    END AS lateral_ms2
  FROM valid_segments
),
pos_scores AS (
  SELECT drive_id, distance, start_date,
    LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, 100 - COALESCE(
      100.0 * (
        COALESCE(SUM(valid_dt) FILTER (WHERE accel_ms2 >  2.943), 0) +
        COALESCE(SUM(valid_dt) FILTER (WHERE accel_ms2 < -2.943), 0) +
        COALESCE(SUM(valid_dt) FILTER (WHERE lateral_ms2 > 3.924), 0)
      ) / NULLIF(SUM(valid_dt), 0), 0)
    )) AS smooth,
    LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, 100 - SUM(CASE WHEN speed > 130 THEN valid_dt * GREATEST(speed - 130, 0) / 2.0 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(valid_dt), 0))) AS spd,
    LEAST(100, SUM(CASE WHEN power < 0 THEN ABS(power) * valid_dt ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN power > 0 THEN power * valid_dt ELSE 0 END), 0) * GREATEST(3, SUM(speed * valid_dt) / NULLIF(SUM(valid_dt), 0) / 20.0)) AS regen,
    SUM(speed * valid_dt) / NULLIF(SUM(valid_dt), 0) AS avg_speed
  FROM pos_raw
  -- 依据 Tesla Safety Score，可复议: 急加/急刹阈值 0.3g≈2.943m/s²；平稳分按严重阈值时间/总有效时长扣分。
  GROUP BY drive_id, distance, start_date
),
position_summary AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(SUM((smooth*0.50 + spd*0.30 + regen*0.20) * distance) / NULLIF(SUM(distance), 0))::integer AS "驾驶风格",
    ROUND(SUM(smooth * distance) / NULLIF(SUM(distance), 0))::integer AS "平稳分",
    ROUND(SUM(spd * distance) / NULLIF(SUM(distance), 0))::integer AS "速度分",
    ROUND(SUM(regen * distance) / NULLIF(SUM(distance), 0))::integer AS "回收分"
  FROM pos_scores
),
range_scores AS (
  SELECT
    d.id,
    d.distance,
    LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, 100 - GREATEST(0,
      (d.start_ideal_range_km - d.end_ideal_range_km) / NULLIF(d.distance, 0) -
      CASE WHEN d.outside_temp_avg < 0 THEN 1.3
           WHEN d.outside_temp_avg < 10 THEN 1.15
           WHEN d.outside_temp_avg > 30 THEN 1.2
           WHEN d.outside_temp_avg > 25 THEN 1.1 ELSE 1.0 END
    ) * 200)) AS eff,
    COALESCE(ps.smooth, 100) AS smooth,
    COALESCE(ps.spd, 100) AS spd,
    COALESCE(ps.regen, 0) AS regen,
    COALESCE(ps.avg_speed, 50) AS avg_speed
  FROM selected_drives d
  LEFT JOIN pos_scores ps ON ps.drive_id = d.id
  WHERE d.start_ideal_range_km IS NOT NULL
    AND d.end_ideal_range_km IS NOT NULL
),
range_summary AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(SUM((CASE
      -- 可复议默认值: 城市/高速按 avg_speed 50/80 km/h 分界；这是场景权重，不是 Tesla 官方阈值。
      WHEN avg_speed < 50 THEN smooth*0.40 + regen*0.30 + spd*0.10 + eff*0.20
      WHEN avg_speed >= 80 THEN smooth*0.20 + regen*0.20 + spd*0.30 + eff*0.30
      ELSE smooth*0.30 + regen*0.20 + spd*0.20 + eff*0.30
    END) * distance) / NULLIF(SUM(distance), 0))::integer AS "综合评分",
    ROUND(SUM(eff * distance) / NULLIF(SUM(distance), 0))::integer AS "效率分"
  FROM range_scores
)
SELECT
  rs."综合评分" AS "综合评分",
  ps."驾驶风格" AS "驾驶风格",
  rs."效率分" AS "效率分",
  ps."平稳分" AS "平稳分",
  ps."速度分" AS "速度分",
  ps."回收分" AS "回收分"
FROM range_summary rs
CROSS JOIN position_summary ps

panels.title: 驾驶风格
panels.description: 纯操作风格评分（不含效率）：平稳50% + 速度30% + 回收20%。平稳分依据 Tesla Safety Score 阈值做超阈时间占比，阈值可复议。

panels.title: 平稳分
panels.description: 平稳分按有效采样时长计算：急加/急刹阈值 0.3g≈2.943m/s²、急转阈值 0.4g≈3.924m/s²；依据 Tesla Safety Score，可复议。急转为 GPS 航向近似。

panels.title: 速度分
panels.description: 超速严重度加权（可复议默认值：>130 km/h 起扣，超速幅度越大扣分越多），并按有效采样时长加权。所有行程按里程加权。

panels.title: 回收分
panels.description: 能量回收比 × 速度动态乘数（可复议默认值：最低 3 倍，速度越高乘数越大）：城市 ×3，100 km/h ×5，120 km/h ×6。有效采样时长积分后按里程加权。

panels.title: 行程评分明细
panels.description: 每次行程的逐项分数（同上方 KPI 同一套规则）：效率分=温度补偿后能耗；平稳分=急加/急刹/急转超阈时间占比；速度分=>130km/h 严重度按时长加权；回收分=回收能量÷消耗能量×动态乘数；综合分按场景权重（可复议：市区<50、混合 50-80、高速≥80）。

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_drives AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT *
  FROM drives
  WHERE car_id = $car_id
    AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
    AND end_date IS NOT NULL
    AND distance > 3
),
points AS (
  SELECT p.drive_id, p.date, p.speed, p.power, p.latitude, p.longitude, d.distance, d.start_date,
    LEAD(p.date) OVER w AS next_date,
    LEAD(p.speed) OVER w AS next_speed,
    LEAD(p.latitude) OVER w AS next_lat,
    LEAD(p.longitude) OVER w AS next_lng,
    LEAD(p.date, 2) OVER w AS next2_date,
    LEAD(p.latitude, 2) OVER w AS next2_lat,
    LEAD(p.longitude, 2) OVER w AS next2_lng
  FROM positions p
  JOIN selected_drives d ON d.id = p.drive_id
  WHERE p.car_id = $car_id
    AND p.date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '1 day')
                   AND ($__timeTo()::timestamp + interval '1 day')
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY p.drive_id ORDER BY p.date)
),
segments AS (
  SELECT *,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_date - date)) AS dt,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next2_date - next_date)) AS next_dt,
    CASE WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND next_lat IS NOT NULL AND next_lng IS NOT NULL THEN
      ATAN2(
        SIN(RADIANS(next_lng - longitude)) * COS(RADIANS(next_lat)),
        COS(RADIANS(latitude)) * SIN(RADIANS(next_lat)) - SIN(RADIANS(latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(next_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(next_lng - longitude))
      )
    END AS bearing1,
    CASE WHEN next_lat IS NOT NULL AND next_lng IS NOT NULL AND next2_lat IS NOT NULL AND next2_lng IS NOT NULL THEN
      ATAN2(
        SIN(RADIANS(next2_lng - next_lng)) * COS(RADIANS(next2_lat)),
        COS(RADIANS(next_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(next2_lat)) - SIN(RADIANS(next_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(next2_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(next2_lng - next_lng))
      )
    END AS bearing2
  FROM points
),
valid_segments AS (
  SELECT *, dt AS valid_dt
  FROM segments
  WHERE dt BETWEEN 0.2 AND 10
),
pos_raw AS (
  SELECT drive_id, speed, power, distance, start_date, valid_dt,
    (next_speed - speed) / valid_dt / 3.6 AS accel_ms2,
    CASE
      -- 依据 Tesla Safety Score，可复议: 急转阈值 0.4g≈3.924m/s²；TeslaMate 无官方横向加速度时用 GPS 航向变化近似。
      WHEN next_dt BETWEEN 0.2 AND 10 AND speed > 5 AND bearing1 IS NOT NULL AND bearing2 IS NOT NULL THEN
        (speed / 3.6) * ABS(ATAN2(SIN(bearing2 - bearing1), COS(bearing2 - bearing1))) / NULLIF(valid_dt, 0)
    END AS lateral_ms2
  FROM valid_segments
),
pos_scores AS (
  SELECT drive_id, distance, start_date,
    LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, 100 - COALESCE(
      100.0 * (
        COALESCE(SUM(valid_dt) FILTER (WHERE accel_ms2 >  2.943), 0) +
        COALESCE(SUM(valid_dt) FILTER (WHERE accel_ms2 < -2.943), 0) +
        COALESCE(SUM(valid_dt) FILTER (WHERE lateral_ms2 > 3.924), 0)
      ) / NULLIF(SUM(valid_dt), 0), 0)
    )) AS smooth,
    LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, 100 - SUM(CASE WHEN speed > 130 THEN valid_dt * GREATEST(speed - 130, 0) / 2.0 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(valid_dt), 0))) AS spd,
    LEAST(100, SUM(CASE WHEN power < 0 THEN ABS(power) * valid_dt ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN power > 0 THEN power * valid_dt ELSE 0 END), 0) * GREATEST(3, SUM(speed * valid_dt) / NULLIF(SUM(valid_dt), 0) / 20.0)) AS regen,
    SUM(speed * valid_dt) / NULLIF(SUM(valid_dt), 0) AS avg_speed
  FROM pos_raw
  -- 依据 Tesla Safety Score，可复议: 急加/急刹阈值 0.3g≈2.943m/s²；平稳分按严重阈值时间/总有效时长扣分。
  GROUP BY drive_id, distance, start_date
)
SELECT
  to_char((d.start_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'), 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "出发时间",
  ROUND(d.distance::numeric, 1) AS "距离(km)",
  d.duration_min AS "时长(分)",
  d.speed_max AS "最高速(km/h)",
  ROUND(COALESCE(ps.avg_speed, 0)::numeric, 1) AS "平均速度(km/h)",
  CASE
    -- 可复议默认值: 城市/高速按 avg_speed 50/80 km/h 分界；这是场景权重，不是 Tesla 官方阈值。
    WHEN COALESCE(ps.avg_speed, 50) < 50 THEN '城市'
    WHEN COALESCE(ps.avg_speed, 50) >= 80 THEN '高速'
    ELSE '混合'
  END AS "场景",
  ROUND(LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, 100 - GREATEST(0, (d.start_ideal_range_km - d.end_ideal_range_km) / NULLIF(d.distance, 0) - CASE WHEN d.outside_temp_avg < 0 THEN 1.3 WHEN d.outside_temp_avg < 10 THEN 1.15 WHEN d.outside_temp_avg > 30 THEN 1.2 WHEN d.outside_temp_avg > 25 THEN 1.1 ELSE 1.0 END) * 200))::numeric) AS "效率分",
  ROUND(COALESCE(ps.smooth, 100)::numeric) AS "平稳分",
  ROUND(COALESCE(ps.spd, 100)::numeric) AS "速度分",
  ROUND(COALESCE(ps.regen, 0)::numeric) AS "回收分",
  ROUND((
    CASE
      -- 可复议默认值: 城市/高速按 avg_speed 50/80 km/h 分界；这是场景权重，不是 Tesla 官方阈值。
      WHEN COALESCE(ps.avg_speed, 50) < 50 THEN COALESCE(ps.smooth, 100)*0.40 + COALESCE(ps.regen, 0)*0.30 + COALESCE(ps.spd, 100)*0.10 + LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, 100 - GREATEST(0, (d.start_ideal_range_km - d.end_ideal_range_km) / NULLIF(d.distance, 0) - CASE WHEN d.outside_temp_avg < 0 THEN 1.3 WHEN d.outside_temp_avg < 10 THEN 1.15 WHEN d.outside_temp_avg > 30 THEN 1.2 WHEN d.outside_temp_avg > 25 THEN 1.1 ELSE 1.0 END) * 200)) * 0.20
      WHEN COALESCE(ps.avg_speed, 50) >= 80 THEN COALESCE(ps.smooth, 100)*0.20 + COALESCE(ps.regen, 0)*0.20 + COALESCE(ps.spd, 100)*0.30 + LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, 100 - GREATEST(0, (d.start_ideal_range_km - d.end_ideal_range_km) / NULLIF(d.distance, 0) - CASE WHEN d.outside_temp_avg < 0 THEN 1.3 WHEN d.outside_temp_avg < 10 THEN 1.15 WHEN d.outside_temp_avg > 30 THEN 1.2 WHEN d.outside_temp_avg > 25 THEN 1.1 ELSE 1.0 END) * 200)) * 0.30
      ELSE COALESCE(ps.smooth, 100)*0.30 + COALESCE(ps.regen, 0)*0.20 + COALESCE(ps.spd, 100)*0.20 + LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, 100 - GREATEST(0, (d.start_ideal_range_km - d.end_ideal_range_km) / NULLIF(d.distance, 0) - CASE WHEN d.outside_temp_avg < 0 THEN 1.3 WHEN d.outside_temp_avg < 10 THEN 1.15 WHEN d.outside_temp_avg > 30 THEN 1.2 WHEN d.outside_temp_avg > 25 THEN 1.1 ELSE 1.0 END) * 200)) * 0.30
    END
  )::numeric) AS "综合评分"
FROM selected_drives d
LEFT JOIN pos_scores ps ON ps.drive_id = d.id
WHERE d.car_id = $car_id
  AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date)
  AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
  AND d.distance > 3
  AND d.start_ideal_range_km IS NOT NULL
  AND d.end_ideal_range_km IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.start_date DESC
LIMIT 100

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS "总行程数"
FROM drives
WHERE car_id = $car_id
  AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
  AND end_date IS NOT NULL
  AND distance > 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(distance)::numeric, 0)::integer AS "总里程(km)"
FROM drives
WHERE car_id = $car_id
  AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
  AND end_date IS NOT NULL
  AND distance > 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG(distance)::numeric, 1) AS "平均行程(km)"
FROM drives
WHERE car_id = $car_id
  AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
  AND end_date IS NOT NULL
  AND distance > 1

SELECT ROUND(MAX(distance)::numeric, 1) AS "最长行程(km)"
FROM drives
WHERE car_id = $car_id
  AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
  AND end_date IS NOT NULL
  AND distance > 1

SELECT MAX(speed_max)::integer AS "最高时速(km/h)"
FROM drives
WHERE car_id = $car_id
  AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
  AND end_date IS NOT NULL
  AND distance > 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(duration_min) / 60.0, 1) AS "总驾驶时长(h)"
FROM drives
WHERE car_id = $car_id
  AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
  AND end_date IS NOT NULL
  AND distance > 1

list.definition:
SELECT
    id as __value,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(id) OVER (PARTITION BY name) > 1 AND name IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(name, ' - ', RIGHT(vin, 6)) ELSE COALESCE(name, CONCAT('VIN ', vin)) end as __text 
FROM cars
ORDER BY display_priority ASC, name ASC, vin ASC;
